title: LET THE BLESSED SAVIOUR IN
author: L.H. parthemore 284
stanzas: Hear the Saviour at the door, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in): He has often knock'd before, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in)Let Him in.
He's your best and truest friend, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in): One who always will defend, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in)  Let Him in.
Do not let Him knock in vain, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in): He may never come again, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in
Hear His gentle, loving voice, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Bid Him welcome, and rejoice, Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in
chorus: 'Tis the Saviour standing at the door (at the door), He's been watching, waiting there before (yes, before); Open wide the heart of sin, Let the blessed Saviour in; Let Him in (Let Him in) Let Him in
